basic_info.description: Updated 3BR+den/2BA fully detached home with great curb appeal and fantastic back yard * Formal grand scale living room with tray ceiling, wood burning fireplace and windows on 2 sides for tremendous natural light * Formal dining room with tray ceiling and built in china cabinet * Updated kitchen with quartz countertops, new stainless steel appliances and separate breakfast area * Large primary bedroom with lush garden outlooks * Sizable guest bedroom on the main level * Remodeled full bath  Upstairs find a family room, updated full bath and 3rd bedroom * Wood floors throughout * Direct access from view deck at kitchen to an amazing 50' wide landscaped yard and patio * Internal access to a 1-car garage; room for an additional 3 cars in the driveway * Fantastic Ingleside Terrace location within walking distance to the shops and restaurants along Ocean Ave including Whole Foods. EZ freeway access
